    self,
    request: ResolvedRequest,
    *,
    timeout_seconds: float | None,
) -> LLMRouterResponse:
    """Run one sync executor attempt with optional timeout."""
    if timeout_seconds is None:
        return self._executor.execute(request)
    pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
    future = pool.submit(self._executor.execute, request)

from __future__ import annotations
import typing
import pytest
import llm_router

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")

_SLOW_SECONDS = 0.3

_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT = 0.2

class _SlowExecutor:
    """Executor double that answers after more than one timeout, under two."""

    def __init__(self, gate: typing.Any) -> None:
        self.gate = gate

    def execute(self, request: object) -> object:
        assert request is not None
        self.gate.wait(_SLOW_SECONDS)
        return "late"

@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_ROUTE_TIMEOUT_FALLBACK[revision==1]")
def test_sync_timeout_has_no_grace_wait_on_same_route() -> None:
    """A route answering after 1.5 timeouts still yields a timeout error."""
    types_mod = typing.sys.modules["llm_router._api.types"]
    gate = typing.sys.modules["threading"].Event()
    executor = _SlowExecutor(gate)
    profile = types_mod.RouterProfile(
        model=types_mod.Model.GEMINI_FLASH,
        provider=types_mod.Provider.GOOGLE,
        attempt_timeout_seconds=_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT,
        max_attempts=1,
    )
    options = {"_executor": executor}
    router = llm_router.LLMRouter([profile], **options)

    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError, match=r"timed out"):
        router.query("hello")
    gate.set()
